method: Risk index = (H·E·V)^⅓ (our geometric mean; factors from the IPCC climate-risk framework)

inputs.hazard: H = P × T × M. P: ESA CCI permafrost fraction. T: ERA5-Land 1–2.89 m soil 0.86 °C → 1 (-5 °C = 0, -1 °C = 1). M: Sentinel-1 (OPERA DISP-S1) multi-year net sinking, 1 cm/yr = 1, × (0.5 + 0.5 × NISAR ground-ice indicator)
inputs.vulnerability: 0.32 (IPCC: susceptibility 0.35 and coping capacity 0.7, researched estimates)

trendSource: OPERA DISP-S1 (Sentinel-1, NASA/JPL), frame F25018, late-summer dates 20160907–20250926
